steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: What of... my tribe...?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Right, and I apologize if I shouldn't have asked.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Oh, it's nothing special. Is there something about us you wanted to know?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yes, actually, I have been doing some... research.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Something that has to do with my tribe?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I don't remember us ever having all that much to do with anyone though...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I could probably count all the mercenaries and merchants that passed through our land before I left on just one hand, and let's not even mention those tribes that intentionally stayed away from the rest of us.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What I want to know is what life was like for you outside the Vouivre Alliance's territory.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: There is very little literature on the subject, and given how chaotic everything is, it's not easy to get to the bottom of everything with each and every tribe...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It's just as you said before. These tribes are practically isolated from the rest of the world.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I don't really mind.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: But why are you interested in this?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: All I can think of is the endless desert, the dry weather, and the hunger there... and the survival techniques I learned just to survive.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I thought I might find these things helpful.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I mean no harm.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'm just doing some investigation into everything that has to do with the Vouivre Alliance.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Are you thinking about going back to Vouivre?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I-I'm not planning on it. At least not right now.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: In the future, though...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Anyway, tell me about the kind of food that your tribe eats, how you cook and train, and what your husbandry techniques are like.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sorry, sorry! I didn't mean to bump into you. Did that hurt...?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It's okay. I don't get hurt very easily.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Huh? Jessica!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Oh, hey there... Vanilla.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Are you busy with something?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: It's nothing that important. I'm just...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm going to Liskarm's to return a book I borrowed from her.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: A book?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I'm so jealous. Both you and Liskarm have read a lot of books, right?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Reading so many words at once is still kinda difficult for me...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: What kind of book did you read, Jessica?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: It's about Vouivre.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Vouivre? What about Vouivre?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Oh, could it be one of those old classics, like the 'Vouivre Agricultural Techniques'—?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sorry to rain on your parade, but...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: It's a romance novel that takes place during the Vouivre War.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: A romance novel... about the Vouivre?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: The flames of war rage... as the battles come to a standstill...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: During this time of chaos when all the mercenary groups are vying for dominance, the female lead charges into her lover's mercenary unit all by herself just to ask for his captain's permission for them to elope...!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Is this a true story? Which mercenary group is that—

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: It's probably just loosely based on real life... I guess.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Well, that's odd. Most people's impression of the Vouivre is that they're all big mercenary lunks.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Here I thought no one would be interested in stories about Vouivre.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Haha... I think it's a pretty good book.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: After reading it, I kind of want to visit Vouivre, if I ever get the chance.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Vanilla, what should I do if I get to visit?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: You want to visit Vouivre?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Is that... weird?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: If you want to know what it's like to live in hell, I could be your bodyguard there and take you around.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I-Is it that bad?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Where I used to live, the people haven't even heard of things like toilets, bathrooms, and kitchens. The whole place's just an endless desert.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Ugh... I'm not sure I could get by there...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Oh, but Liskarm's from an Alliance-controlled area. That might be closer to the stuff you read about in the book.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Well, unlike where I used to live, the enemy there isn't nature itself. They contend with the even greater chaos of society there.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: The Alliance's territory is more chaotic than the outside...? That's not something they ever talk about in the book.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Honestly, I don't really know what it's like in there.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Liskarm asked me about life back home before, and when we started talking about it, she said it wasn't all that peaceful of a place.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I spent most of my childhood with my tribe, and it was always a struggle between life and death, but I did get to live pretty free, aside from all that.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: But the adults also told me that Vouivre was a mess.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Hmm... I don't really know much more, so maybe you should go ask Liskarm.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: She just asked me not too long ago how life was with my tribe, too.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Huh? Really?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I'm sure she could explain Vouivre much better than me.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: That romance part, though...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Tell me more about that next time.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'd be glad to, if you're interested.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (I'm so curious about Vouivre right now because of the book.)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (But... I really didn't know that's how Vanilla saw the place.)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (It sounds much worse than the book makes it out to be.)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (What about Liskarm? I wonder what she thinks of her homeland...)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Excuse me, Liskarm? It's Jessica.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Liskarm?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'm here. Come in.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'm drying my hair. Wait there for a moment.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (Whoa... Compared to the last time I was here, there's so many books.)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (So many reports, too.)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (Liskarm's not just amazing in battle. She's also so knowledgeable. Plus, she's always so serious...)

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Hm? What's this report here...?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: 'A Survey of the Popularity and Reputation of Mercenary Groups within the Vouivre Alliance?'

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: And this. 'On the Tribes of the Vouivre Region...' I found it...!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What did you find?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Eep! I-I'm sorry, Liskarm. I shouldn't have looked...!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Phew—I was just taking a shower after training.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Did you need something from me, Jessica? If I remember correctly...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I... I'm here to return the novel I borrowed from you.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Just leave it on the table. I'll take care of it.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Huh? This book...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I-Is there a problem?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: No... I'm probably just mistaken...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If you borrowed it from me and you're bringing it back now, it's not an issue.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: *Whimper*... Thanks, Liskarm.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Then...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Something on your mind, Jessica...?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I... Yeah...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Now, don't be so reserved. Take a seat.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: This isn't Blacksteel. You don't need to try to be so polite around me.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We are friends, aren't we?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Liskarm...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I see... So you don't trust me...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: O-Of course I trust you. O-Okay...!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Ha.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You haven't changed at all, Jessica.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm trying my best...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: There's a tough side to you, and unlike before, you know how to bring that part of you out now.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: But well...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You freak out whenever you're scared. That hasn't changed.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: *Whimpers*... You make fun of me just like Franka does now.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Oh, no, I'm not as much of a meanie as her.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Right... No, I mean... That's not what I meant!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Franka isn't really that much of a meanie, but she always pranks the rest of us all of a sudden—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: —And her jokes are terrible.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Ahem... Okay, I'll try not to badmouth her. You wouldn't know how to respond otherwise.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: So, was there something on my shelf that caught your eye just now?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Well, I guess it wasn't a book that I was interested in... It's more like Vouivre itself that I'm trying to know more about.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Vouivre?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: After I finished the novel, I wanted to know more about the story's setting.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You've been looking into Vouivre and the organizations there, right?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Hm? How'd you know?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sorry, I... I saw the report on your desk just now.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: And I also heard...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Well... These reports aren't really anything that special.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It's just... a habit of mine.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I was born in Vouivre, after all.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It wasn't until I'd left that I started to understand what a difficult situation my homeland is in... and what that actually meant for people outside.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: But there is nothing I can do about the status quo.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: All I can do is to understand what is going on there to the best of my ability and to think about what I might do about it.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I remember now. You told me before at Blacksteel.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: That Vouivre needs a PMC that's different than the other ones.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Thinking back... I must've been so rash and naive for even coming up with that idea.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I-I think it's great to be ambitious!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I mean, it was you who plucked me out of the Equipment Department and asked me to join your team.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: It was only because of your advice that I came here to Rhodes Island. I wouldn't have changed so much otherwise.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Back there, I didn't have any friends I could open up to, not to mention dreams.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I've always been very thankful of you, Liskarm. J-Just like How Franka found Vanilla—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Franka actually looked at all the recruits to find Vanilla.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: All I did was run a few searches on the Blacksteel roster. That's all it took to find you.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You have such amazing potential. It was a waste for you to work in Equipment Testing.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: All those days gone by... They're all some really great memories... Yeah.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Looking back, I was just far too naive.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I thought I could start my own PMC as soon as I figured out the way Blacksteel operates.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: For the past few years, all I've ever paid attention to was Blacksteel's expansion.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: If that was your goal all along, why did you go to the Biochemistry Department?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I had a few bottlenecks...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It's all pretty clear to me in hindsight, but everything was just a haze to me back then.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: The things that Blacksteel asked of me just didn't seem to be anything like the 'peace' I had in mind. I was always hesitating during my missions.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: That contradiction tormented me. If Dr. Longfellow hadn't assigned me to Biochemistry, I probably would still be tormenting myself.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Jessica... We've been working in Rhodes Island for a while now. What do you think of this place?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I-I feel honored to be here!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I get to keep working with you and Franka, and I've changed a lot ever since I got here.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Back at Blacksteel, I just didn't have any friends I could open up to.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But I have a lot of friends here who will hear me out... and I've gotten a lot of help from everyone.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I think coming to Rhodes Island has got to be one of the most important things that ever happened to me!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yeah... That's good.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: What about you, Liskarm? That reminds me. You and Franka were the first two Blacksteel employees who came to Rhodes Island, right?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: A-Ahem.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Right. Back then...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You two just left without saying a word. I was so nervous.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I was so worried you were abandoning us.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: It wasn't until later that I heard you were transferred to Rhodes Island with Franka.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Well, what else could I have done? She was my one and only partner...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Besides, I just didn't understand how Blacksteel did things back then. I was perhaps even more confused than you.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: And I'd shelved my goals for a good while too.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You don't mean... that Blacksteel has some dark secrets...!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I think Blacksteel is a good company.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It's just... I guess I started seeing things differently at some point.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I thought Blacksteel had a different philosophy than the other mercenary groups out there, and I thought that was the best way to unite all the disorganized mercenaries in Vouivre, to fix the way they live.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yet reality and my beliefs are two separate matters. My principles and actions don't always line up with each other either.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I... I think so too...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Blacksteel's operations help maintain the peace where it operates, but that peace is on the surface only.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: It wasn't until I came to Rhodes Island that I understood things can actually be far grimmer.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: That's also why I never talk about those ideas I had anymore. They're way too foolish.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Rather than a security company that focuses only on opportunities, I think it's far more important to focus on your personal mission and responsibility.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Jessica, have you heard that, though deadlocked, Vouivre is still at war, and how it is completely disorganized?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I heard some stories about it before, but now that I've finished this book...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I want to learn more about Vouivre.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I used to think that perhaps the people out there just didn't know how to help Vouivre out of the hole it's found itself in.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It wasn't until I'd left and joined Blacksteel that I realized hardly anyone even knew how hard life was in Vouivre, or should I say... no one cared.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: But I still wanted to make my homeland a safe place to life.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I want to make it a place where people from Vouivre would want to go back. I want to bring everyone together, to turn it into a place that can defend itself even without the PMCs outside.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I heard you babble about how Vouivre needs a security company to bring it peace while you were drunk one time. Is this what that was all about...?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: That was just drunk talk!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I just started putting together these data on Vouivre not too long ago...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: G-Gathering intel is just a habit of mine. It's got nothing to do with ambitions or whatever!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: So don't make fun of me...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I wouldn't! I am sure you can accomplish anything you set your mind to.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: From the moment I first met you, I've never seen you slack off, whether it was back in Blacksteel or here in Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Although you've been drinking with Franka a lot more ever since you came here.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: That's all her fault.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: She said she was going to fix how deadpan I was, and this was the way she went about it...!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But I think you live a much more fulfilling life now.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You smile a lot more too.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I think... Franka changed you for the better...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: She may have become infected, but she's still trying to make her life more delightful.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: She's serious when it's time to be serious, and she enjoys life whenever it's the right time to.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If we were still at Blacksteel, she wouldn't have that luxury. Blacksteel doesn't give its Infected members that kind of treatment...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: And don't even ask if they'd let us stay together as partners.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Even though Franka got infected, she was still able to think about how to live her life to the fullest.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: On the other hand, I... I'm nothing compared to her.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But haven't you already found your goal, Liskarm?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You want to go back home, and to bring peace and change to Vouivre.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I know you'd definitely give it a lot more thought than me. I-I'm sure of it!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'm... still not strong enough.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I don't have a clear goal like Franka does.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I still don't have the slightest clue what I'd have to do to start a new organization and run the whole shop myself.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Even so, I know it's definitely possible to bring change to Vouivre with the power I have.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I really think so.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm sure it is!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Vanilla told me that Vouivre has lots of special dances and food, and even though life may be pretty simple for the tribes in the outskirts... they are all very hopeful about the future.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Looks like you're getting all hyped up about Vouivre again.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Well, I mean... both the story and the protagonist are really special in this book.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm sure stories that take place in Vouivre will become more and more popular.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I... I even want to pay Vouivre a visit, actually. Just once.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Of course... If I have time, I could take you around and be your bodyguard.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Not even you too, Liskarm... *Whimpers*... Is Vouivre such a scary place?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Right now? It's way too dangerous.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Coming across bandits is the least of your worries. If you found yourself caught in a fight between the mercenaries there...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: T-That's a little...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: That being said, Vouivre will become a place that's worth paying a visit, Jessica.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: When that happens, you won't need a bodyguard. You'll be able to travel through the countryside, the wilderness, and the cities freely.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: And to make that happen...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: *Yawns*... Hey, Liskarm, you there?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Who told you to just come in without knocking—

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What'cha writing?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Don't just go looking at my report.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hm? What's this? A novel?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Don't just start rummaging through my bookshelf either.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: 'Vouivre Love...' Oh, isn't this—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I knew it. This is yours.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Isn't this the romance novel I left in your room?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So you really didn't care for it, huh...?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's such an emotional story. Kinda makes me want to start a book club about it.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So you never so much as opened it after I lent it to you?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Jessica borrowed it from me the other day, and she just returned it.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Well, I'll talk to Jessica about it, then. I'm never recommending books to you ever again, you party pooper.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Hmph, it's just a made up story. There's no reason to read it.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You know, this is the hottest romance epic among girls right now, and it's one of the few stories out there that takes place in Vouivre.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I guess it's kinda weird to have someone from Vouivre read a Columbian novel about Vouivre, but still.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I actually wouldn't mind hearing you criticize how different the book is from the real life over there.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Well, I can tell you at the very least that your favorite part, the part where they keep sending letters to each other, is never going to happen there.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: But well... After she finished the book, Jessica now knows a lot of the places and names there.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: She's also very curious about Vouivre now. Even borrowed quite a few of my research reports.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: That's the kind of power that novels have.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yeah, I guess I could research it from a cultural perspective.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You know, you really aren't a romantic at all.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We just aren't interested in the same genres.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If you'd brought me some sci-fi...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: That's got no romance in it at all.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It's weaponry and equipment research! Anything wrong with that?!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: A-Anyway, did you need me for something?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hm... What was it again?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Just kidding.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: We got a new mission. Mutant Originium Slugs.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I was kinda thinking I could just take this mission on by myself or not tell you at all, and you'd be so mad.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So how about it? Wanna come join me on the hunt?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (Breathes in)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (Breathes out)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I just finished this report.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Alrighty then.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Well—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Let's get going already.
